        <advanced_script><![CDATA[// New Business update: branch on how far the journey actually got.
// Variables: submission, policy, progress, plan, modules, simple, answer
if (progress.clearance.exists && progress.clearance.status !== 'complete') {

    // Still in clearance - reuse the existing cases and redo them.
    answer = [
        { module: 'clearance',           order: 1, restart: 'override' },
        { module: 'risk_assessment',     order: 2, restart: 'override' },
        { module: 'exposure_management', order: 2, restart: 'override' },
        { module: 'quote_and_bind',      order: 3, restart: 'none' }
    ];

} else if (progress.quote_and_bind.exists) {

    // Already quoting - re-cut the quote as a new version, leave the rest.
    answer = [
        { module: 'quote_and_bind', order: 1, restart: 'new_version' }
    ];

} else {

    // Anything else: fall back to this row's own columns.
    answer = simple;
}]]></advanced_script>
